parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.swift`. The near-duplicate signal (Jaccard 0.78) reflects that `PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.multipleStopCallsAreIdempotent` (line 132) and `StopBehaviorTests.stopIsIdempotent` (line 214) are testing the same idempotency property from two different test-class perspectives — a common and intentional pattern in behavior-driven test suites where the same invariant is exercised in different contexts.
